explication: Epstein Document Network Explorer turns source documents into an AI-extracted relationship network, then serves it through an interactive graph, filters, timeline, and document viewer. The documented primary workflow is document extraction and analysis into SQLite, followed by API-backed exploration. The README also describes semantic tagging, tag clustering, entity deduplication, and incremental ingestion. Pipeline internals and server routes were not excerpted, so pipeline links follow documented capabilities; no unshown implementation details are inferred.
